description: API and MCP surface changes: recycler bid submission API (Task 1 API layer), MCP UNVERIFIED stubs (Task 8), logistics agent UNVERIFIED e-way bill (Task 9). Independent of FEAT-002 except that FEAT-003's bid API depends on the corridor_min/corridor_max migration from FEAT-001.
steps: 1. [Task 1 API] In api/src/routes/auctions.py, add POST /auctions/{auction_id}/bids endpoint. Add a local Pydantic model BidSubmitRequest(BaseModel): volume_tons: float; price_per_kg: float. In the handler: add tenant_ctx: TenantCtx = Depends(get_tenant_ctx) dependency. Guard: if tenant_ctx.role != 'recycler': raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail='recycler role required'). Fetch AuctionRecord for auction_id from DB; raise 404 if not found; raise 400 if status != 'ACTIVE'. Validate price corridor: effective_min = auction.corridor_min if auction.corridor_min is not None else auction.floor_price_inr; effective_max = auction.corridor_max if auction.corridor_max is not None else auction.ceiling_price_inr. If not effective_min <= price_per_kg <= effective_max: raise HTTPException(422, detail=f'price_per_kg {price_per_kg} outside corridor [{effective_min}, {effective_max}]'). Create BidRecord: bid_id=f'BID-{uuid4().hex[:8].upper()}', auction_id=auction_id, recycler_id=tenant_ctx.org_id, org_id=tenant_ctx.org_id, volume_tons=body.volume_tons, price_per_kg=body.price_per_kg, category=auction.category, status='BIDDING'. Add to session, commit. Return JSONResponse(status_code=201, content=bid.to_dict()).

2. [Task 1 API] Update GET /auctions/{auction_id}/bids (list_auction_bids) in api/src/routes/auctions.py: add tenant_ctx: TenantCtx = Depends(get_tenant_ctx). In _get_bids helper or inline: if tenant_ctx.is_platform_admin or tenant_ctx.role == 'brand_owner': return all bids. If tenant_ctx.role == 'recycler': filter WHERE org_id = tenant_ctx.org_id. Update _get_bids signature to accept optional org_id filter or do the filtering inline in list_auction_bids.

3. [Task 8] In mcp/src/tools/gst_tool.py, replace entire return dict of verify_bill() with: return {'status': 'UNVERIFIED', 'message': 'Live GST E-Way Bill API not connected. Manual verification required.', 'verified': False, 'eway_bill_number': bill_str}. Remove all seed/digest logic (the method can still accept the parameter for interface compatibility).

4. [Task 8] In mcp/src/tools/cpcb_tool.py, replace entire return dict of verify_cto() with: return {'status': 'UNVERIFIED', 'message': 'Live CPCB registry API not connected. Manual verification required.', 'verified': False, 'recycler_id': rec_id, 'plant_id': p_id}. Remove all seed/digest logic.

5. [Task 9] In worker/src/agents/logistics_agent.py, replace the body of verify_eway_bill() tool function with: return {'eway_bill_number': eway_bill_number, 'status': 'UNVERIFIED', 'message': 'Live GST E-Way Bill API not connected. Manual verification required.', 'verified': False}.

6. [Task 9] In worker/src/agents/logistics_agent.py run_logistics_agent(), after parsing the JSON result: if result.get('verdict') == 'APPROVE' and not result.get('verified', True): result['verdict'] = 'MANUAL_REVIEW'; result['requires_hitl'] = True. Also ensure the assess_logistics_risk tool correctly propagates unverified status: eway_result.get('origin_verified', False) will now be False since the stub does not set it, so fraud flags will fire and verdict will be MANUAL_REVIEW naturally.

7. [Task 9] In worker/src/flows/workflows.py Stage 3a (MasterEPRComplianceWorkflow): after the verify_eway_bill_activity call, add: if eway.get('status') == 'UNVERIFIED' or eway.get('requires_hitl'): audit['requires_hitl'] = True  — use a placeholder dict if audit hasn't been set yet (set a pre-audit flag). The simplest implementation: set a local variable eway_requires_hitl = eway.get('status') == 'UNVERIFIED', then OR it into the is_fraudulent check at the bottom of Stage 3b.
acceptance_criteria: POST /auctions/{id}/bids returns 201 with bid dict for recycler role with valid price
